name: Rock Shelters of Bhimbetka
description: Tucked into forested sandstone hills in Madhya Pradesh, about 45 km southeast of Bhopal, Bhimbetka holds more than 750 rock shelters spread over roughly 10 km. Some were lived in over 100,000 years ago. Their walls carry paintings of animals, hunters, dancers and later horse-mounted warriors, with the oldest dated to around 10,000 BCE, making this some of India's earliest known rock art.
